verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own documentation has an 'Install an application' topic, and the marketing page says popular apps such as Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam and OBS Studio are available, so first-party app installation is documented. Nothing in the pack names a built-in graphical app store or describes one-click installation, so the core 'built-in store, single click' part is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a built-in app store (e.g. App Center/Ubuntu Software), documentation of a one-click install flow, confirmation that the named popular apps are installable from that store, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install popular desktop apps with a single click from a built-in app store
